title: Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) - Treaty stream - After you register

sections.heading: Monitor my registration
sections.text:
You can check the status of your registration in your ImmiAccount. Your registration in ImmiAccount will show one of the following:

Meaning of each registration status as shown in ImmiAccount
Registration status | Description
Draft | You must submit and pay for your registration to enter the Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream (Tuvalu) ballot.
Ready for payment | Your registration is ready for payment. Once your payment is completed and cleared, the registration will be added to the ballot. Use the My payments tab to check the status of your payment.
Awaiting payment | You have chosen to pay using BPAY. Contact your financial institution and use the details provided to make the payment. To enter the Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream (Tuvalu) ballot your payment must be completed and cleared. Use the My payments tab to check the status of your payment or to change your payment method.
Received | We have received your registration for the Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream (Tuvalu) ballot.
Selected | You have been randomly selected in the ballot to apply for a Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream (Tuvalu) . You must apply for your visa on or before the date provided in your Notification of Selection letter.
Visa application submitted | Your Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream (Tuvalu) application has been submitted and will be assessed.
Selection expired | As you were randomly selected to apply for a Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream (Tuvalu) , your registration in this ballot is no longer active. If you did not apply for the Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream (Tuvalu) in the required time limit, you cannot use this registration. You must submit a new registration to enter a future Pacific Engagement visa ballot.
Expired | Your registration in the Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream (Tuvalu) ballot is expired and no longer eligible for random selection.

sections.heading: Tell us if things change
sections.text: Keep your email address and passport details up to date so we can contact you if you are randomly selected in the ballot to submit an application. Select the ‘View details’ button on your application in ImmiAccount if you need to update your details.

sections.heading: Withdrawing your registration
sections.text:
You can withdraw your registration at any time during the ballot process in ImmiAccount.

For more information, see Refunds.

sections.heading: Stay lawful
sections.text:
A registration in the Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) – Treaty stream (Tuvalu) ballot is not a visa application.

If your visa is about to expire, you must apply for another visa to stay in Australia lawfully.

Submitting a registration does not mean you will get a bridging visa.

You are only eligible for a bridging visa after you are selected in the ballot and apply for the visa.

sections.heading: Ballot Selection process
sections.text:
You can see the status of the ballot in the PEV Treaty stream Country Ballot Status table.

We will show the ballot selection period (open and close dates) for when the random selection of registrations will occur for the Tuvalu ballot on the PEV Treaty stream Country Ballot Status page.

We will select registrations from the Tuvalu ballot at random.

We cannot give you information about the status of your ballot. We will tell you if you are successful in the ballot.

After the ballot selection process is shown as Expired no further registrations will be selected.

sections.heading: Ballot Selection process > If you are successful in the ballot
sections.text:
If you are randomly selected in the ballot we will send you a Notification of Selection letter. This letter will have a link and details on how to apply for a Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) - Treaty stream (Tuvalu).

You must apply for the visa on or before the date specified in your notification letter. We cannot accept your application if you try to apply after this date. You can find more information on the
Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) - Treaty stream (Tuvalu) Eligibility page.

You must complete the visa application using the same passport that you used to register in the ballot.

If your passport expires between the time of registration and time of visa application, you must let us know. You can tell us about your change in passport details via ImmiAccount. For more information see You have a new passport.

You must submit your visa application using the link provided to you in the notification email or through your ImmiAccount. Make sure you submit your application on time so you do not miss out.

sections.heading: Ballot Selection process > If you are unsuccessful in the ballot
sections.text: If you are not randomly selected in the Treaty stream ballot you cannot apply for the Pacific Engagement (subclass 192) - Treaty stream visa.

sections.heading: Ballot Selection process > Ballot Registration Expiry
sections.text:
Your registration will expire after we finalise the ballot selection process.

If the status of your registration in ImmiAccount is ‘expired’, it means that you are no longer registered in the ballot.

You may be able to register in the next ballot process if you still meet the eligibility requirements.
